metadata.title: Matching Random Point Sets with Minimum Distortion
metadata.abstract: How well can two independent random samples from a metric measure space be matched while preserving pairwise distances? Concretely, given two independent copies, each of $n$ points sampled from the space, what is their typical metric distortion as finite $n$-point metric spaces? We prove that the space $[0,1]$ equipped with the uniform measure already exhibits a rich behavior. We show that with high probability the distortion of the two independent samples is $n^{2/3}$ up to polylogarithmic factors. The lower bound reflects two competing obstructions. A bijection that maps points close to their original positions or their reflections in $[0,1]$ must expand the smallest gaps, in both directions. On the other hand, we show that large displacement from both the identity and reflection itself forces large distortion. Balancing these obstructions yields the lower-bound exponent $2/3$. For the upper bound, we construct a partial matching of the points that maps each gap between consecutive points of length $d\lesssim n^{-4/3}$ to a pair at distance $\widetilde{O}(dn^{1/3})$, with analogous control in the reverse direction. We then use a delicate multiscale oscillation construction to extend this partial matching to a low-distortion bijection.
metadata.comment: 47 pages, 9 figures. Includes a six-page technical overview explaining the main ideas and proof techniques

analysis.workSummary: 设X、Y为[0,1]上两份独立的n个iid均匀点样本，取诱导Euclidean度量。双射f的dist(f)=Lip(f)Lip(f^(-1))，c(X,Y)为所有双射的最小值。定理1.1给普适C>0，以概率1−o(1)满足n^(2/3)/(log n)^C≤c(X,Y)≤n^(2/3)(log n)^C。该畸变对两份度量独立缩放均不变。
techniques: 均匀间隙的独立指数变量表示
最小间隙与恒等/反射附近的窗口障碍
等距网格置换的位移—畸变界
分块重排和多尺度振荡延拓
analysis.breakthrough: 下界中，小位移匹配的双向扩张产生约(n/T)²的畸变下界，大位移通过置换畸变产生约T的下界，在T约n^(2/3)平衡。上界以多对数修正后的n^(−4/3) tiny间隙阈值建立部分匹配，再延拓至两个方向Lipschitz常数均为n^(1/3)乘多对数的双射。附录B证明对每n≥3，E[c(X,Y)]=∞。
analysis.limitations: 典型阶为n→∞的高概率陈述，保留多对数因子。适用背景是区间均匀独立样本，两方向常数的乘积与单向Lipschitz常数应按定义区分。已核第2页定义及定理、指数模型和下界平衡、上界构造纲要/关键命题及附录B，渲染第2页；未逐行检查§6全部模式概率与振荡拼接，也未验证附录A的完整组合论证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者先发展主定理策略，ChatGPT-6具体建议改用Prop2.3的指数表示以利用间隙独立性、简化Prop6.5，并辅助选择把上界精化到多对数误差的参数。模型还给出附录A的woven permutations定义和证明，其中LemmaA.6给定理4.1一个较短证明，正文保留作者原证明。模型亦广泛辅助写作及制图。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.06845v1 · PDF 第4页，Use of AI
